notes.title: v1.8.1 - Scenery Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272144/d07e0681ddb99ba16b445cc455dc9798efffb797.png

In this quick patch / update,

Scenery has been fixed, to no longer move when fish interact with it.

This means,
- plants
- rocks
- other items
are safe from being ejected from the tank, due to fish pressing things around.

As always if anything does exit the tank, it will SAFELY spawn back in.

This is just far less likely to occur now, and you can layer / decorate your tank more!

Thanks for @m3gm3g for reporting this issue,

Have a good one,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272144/70e3e77d77ef2ae4061f9f1b762dd3818857f5ec.png

notes.title: v1.4.2 Update
notes.notes:
For this update, I've got a few minor changes that were much needed.

- When fish are really hungry, 3 or less health an audible alert will be heard now, this allows you to look away for a moment and not lose a fish

- I've enhanced the coloration of the fish, there was a transparency that wasn't needed and is now removed (I may increase the front glass opacity in the next update, stay tuned.)

- Added descriptions to everything in the shop to help with the buying experience

- Expanded the available colors that fish can be, there's a wider range of colors for which fish can be

- Added an ON/OFF switch to the auto-feeder if you desire to turn it off momentarily

The game rebalance went well, and NO changes to the balance of the gameplay were made in this update.

notes.title: v1.3 Scenery Update
notes.notes:
Hello Fishtankers,

For this update I've been working hard on some scenery and plants, however, a few are taking a bit longer with some physics issues. 

So I'm releasing this update now to pave the way for more plants,
This update, marked "1.3" is the first, "scenery update", which includes:

- Small rocks (You can have a max of 50)
- Medium rocks (You can have a max of 25)
- Large rocks (You can have a max of 10)
- Anubias Plant (You can have a max of 5)

The snow from the winter update is still available as an item in the shop called "Winter Wonderland Substrate" which when equipped will give your tank a "snowy" effect (fish will remain unharmed). ːwinter2019happybulbː

This update also includes several bug fixes. ːsteamthumbsupː
If you have any bugs please report them on Discord (invite can be found in-game settings)

The largest parts of this update are upgrades to internal systems for:
- Bag / Inventory
- Tank Scenery (Placement, saving, loading)
- Substrates (Buying, saving, loading)

These updates are less "seen" but provide a clear pathway for content expansion. ːwinter2019cooldogː

The next updates will include new content, (Fish, Plants, Scenery, etc)

Stay tuned, I have 1.4 through 1.7 planned,
it's going to be a great year for Fish & Bubbles!

P.S. don't overload your tank XD
https://fishandbubbles.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/1.3/scenery.png

notes.title: v1.1 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys, ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Hope you had a fun Halloween, this Nov 1 update removes the Halloween stuff.

Two new Substrates have been added

Yellow:

https://fishandbubbles.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/1.1/yellow_substrate.png

and...

Ocean Blue:

https://fishandbubbles.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/1.1/ocean_blue_substrate.png

This update may seem minor, but underneath the hood I've changed thousands of lines...

A few key points to the code changes & cleanup

- Substrate / Item code, which will allow for easier addition of new items

- Fish v2, completely re-written file which now has:
    - several optimizations to improve performance
    - a singular sprite which is programmatically controlled
    - no more sounds on each fish (instead they are now game global)

This will allow new fish types to be added with ease.

Expect there to be some quirks with the fish behavior, I plan to release updates in the coming weeks to polish this behavior and further tune it. Feedback on the Discord is greatly appreciated & welcome.

That's all for now,
-d4rkd0s

notes.title: New Beta Release v1.0.0-rc5
notes.notes:
1.0.0-rc5 is now live and contains the following improvements:

- Greatly improved user experience of feeding by auto dropping food when you hit the water
- Improved save file loading to load entire file (if you format the JSON in your savefile it doesn't cause it to break anymore)
- Made fish zoom in less, and more centered
- Added Guppy fish (comes in two styles, Normal and Vivid)

1.0.0-rc5 contains the following known bugs:

- Colors of fish are loading incorrectly, enjoy random rainbow puffers+guppys for RC5
- Guppy and Puffer fish need proper fin animations
- Overall performance could be improved currently the game supports 20-30 fish

notes.title: New Beta Release v1.0.0-rc4
notes.notes:
1.0.0-rc4 is now live and contains the following improvements:

-  You can now see the "-rc#" of the current build (the full version number) in the game
- Added "Open save file location" button to Settings
- Fixed zoom-in / click on fish and open/close the info panel
- Made the flakes move slightly quicker
- Made the flakes slide along the edge of the glass, to make feeding less annoying
- Doubled autosave interval time
- Fixed various scenarios where the shop would remain open when it should be closed
- Fixed fish so they point/look at what they are eating (as well as where they are moving)
- Fixed up the shop (new expand animation)
- Fixed purchase of Air Pump
- Added tracking of "items" purchased to save/load (savefile)
- Blocked saving during fish respawn to help prevent any "fish data loss" in very rare cases

1.0.0-rc4 contains the following known bugs:

- When the pellet hits the water it isn't auto dropped / released
- When loading the save file, if formatted (longer than 1 line) loading fails, needs swapping to full file loading
- Fish collide with each other (as the tank gets populated this might become an issue, and I'll want them to be able to swim "around" or "behind" each other, TBD what I do here)
- Overall performance could be improved currently the game supports 20-30 fish

notes.title: New Beta Release v1.0.0-rc3
notes.notes:
1.0.0-rc3 is now live and contains the following improvements:


 Organized Fish Node Structure for new upcoming species
 Increased Autosave Time & Improved Saving / Loading Overall
 z-index layering overhauled, settings no longer has a background


1.0.0-rc3 contains the following known bugs:


 Air Pump Item is still not fully functional and is currently disabled
 Add hard block on saving during fish teleports/respawn, (fish can be entirely lost, but this is extremely rare, a fish has to escape the tank and you have to be saving the game while it teleports back into the tank)
 Direction of movement for fish incorrectly points the image of the fish
 SFX Volume control is on slide update, and needs to be changed to on interval check update, to help on really slow machines
 Autosave seconds interval for launch needs to be increased / configurable
